policy: Record only the strongest claim directly supported by exercised evidence. Every entry must list untested boundaries and remaining uncertainty. Never infer production finality from local, mock, CI, preview or synthetic evidence.

exercised_boundaries: string

exercised_boundaries: All 14 tracked src/app/api/v1 route files are represented by 16 method/path inventory records.
All process.env keys referenced by tracked TypeScript runtime source are represented in the inventory.
Open API PRs #26-#31 were inspected through GitHub metadata and PR #31 was compared locally against main without treating draft files as current truth.

Known-bad omitted-route and duplicate-ID fixtures failed the inventory verifier.
Compliance, TypeScript, ESLint and all 81 pre-sensitivity full-suite tests passed; the focused topology suite passed 7/7 after sensitivity coverage was added.
The production Next.js build completed successfully after font-network access was available.

Sultan OS repository runtime and direct-write inventory
live Postgres schema and provider reachability
object-by-object canonical mutation and readback ownership
merged compatibility of the draft PR #31 control plane

The main dependency graph retains unresolved audit findings.

entries.claim: The API now publishes desired, observed, freshness and reconciliation state without allowing stored connector configuration to masquerade as provider observation.

Shopify projection state uses the canonical sync ledger and a 48-hour freshness window.
Typecheck, lint, compliance, 96/96 tests and the production build passed.

The existing legacy connector status fields remain for compatibility.
